free_tier.stated: USD 6.00/month: 2 EPYC cores (shared), 4,000 MB RAM, 64 GB NVMe, 2,000 GB/month bandwidth on a 2.4 Gbps port, IPv4 + IPv6, Johor Malaysia; the tracker slug is KVM_Premium_1_Johor_Bahru_MY.
